audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer gives Katarina all seven rows while the full layer reads Katarina/Katarina/Katarina/Skill/Katarina/Skill/Vladimir. Three rows disagree across layers, and a 7/7 sweep contradicts a 47.27% win rate.
audit.why: Levels 3-5 are genuinely Katarina's: Transfusion is a 9s single-target heal at rank 1 with long dead windows and Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1. The late game is not — Crimson Pact converts every point of AP into health, so a 3-item Vladimir out-durables your entries.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 5 to Katarina in the full layer, row 6 to Vladimir in the content layer, with the matching whys rewritten.

audit.why: spikes[] already place the peak at 3-5, the flip at late, and correctly note Hemoplague's delayed payoff on a flat 120s cooldown against your 75/60/45 Death Lotus.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions are never stated. First: Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir untargetable for 2 seconds but does not CC you, so it does not cancel Death Lotus — the page repeatedly implies pool 'neutralises' your ult. Second: Death Lotus applies healing reduction, which is the direct counter to Transfusion and to Hemoplague's heal-per-champion-hit.
audit.why: ownerKit R carries flags channel (interruptible by CC) and antiHeal; Vladimir's kit contains no CC at all — only a slow on W and E. Nothing he owns can interrupt your channel.
audit.corrected: State that pool dodges the damage but not the channel, and that your R is your own Grievous Wounds against his two heal sources.
sources: enemyKit full ability list — no hardCC

audit.why: The kit gives Transfusion 9s down to 4.6s, Sanguine Pool 28s down to 16s, Tides of Blood 13s down to 5s, Hemoplague a flat 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d is tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d is tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED). dontsFull[0].t and dontsFull[2].t both reference CC and spell shields Vladimir does not own; dontsFull[0].d calls a held stun 'Vladimir's rehearsed moment' when he has no stun.
audit.why: Vladimir's kit has no stun, no spell shield and no interrupt. Those bullets are enemy-agnostic template text and are factually wrong here.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to pool timing and Crimson Pact scaling.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shunpo (second use) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.

edits.before: If Vladimir gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Sanguine Pool extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q bounces and stay relevant through reset potential.

edits.before: You are the cleanup that starts fights: enter on steel, lotus the clump, reset through the kill, and exit through the panic.
edits.after: You are the executioner, not the brawler: catch him rotating in fog where 2 seconds of pool only delays it, and never open a fight he is standing in front of.

edits.before: Punish immediately. Level 1 Vladimir has one of the worst laning stat lines in mid: no resource bar means Transfusion is his everything, and its early 9-second cooldown leaves long dead windows. Auto and Bouncing Blade him every time Q comes off a minion. He has no pool until 2-3 and usually skills it late — extended level 1-2 trades are heavily yours. Deny him the early CS he needs, because every point of his scaling is on a timer you control.

notes: Full and content level charts disagreed on rows 3, 5 and 6. Rows 3 and 5 fixed in the full layer (content already read Katarina); row 6 fixed in the content layer (full already read Vladimir) with whys[6] and phases[6].why rewritten to match. The packet defect is real and now resolved: the chart no longer gives Katarina 7/7 against a 47.27% win rate. Corrected a factual error the page repeats: Sanguine Pool does NOT cancel Death Lotus — Vladimir's kit contains no CC of any kind, only slows, so the untargetability dodges damage while the channel continues. Also surfaced Death Lotus's healing reduction as the direct counter to Transfusion and Hemoplague, which the page never mentioned. 'Bouncing Blade' removed from early: Riot's text for Katarina's Q carries no ability name in the kit file, so I described the mechanic rather than assert a name. Unverified and left alone: the '4-second' Hemoplague delay and the '20% of his own health' pool self-tax quoted in mid and spikes[3] — the kit gives no numbers for either; the mid entry still contains the self-tax figure.
